messages:
Raj Patel: @channel handing off Olympus (mid-market fintech) to CS. Summary: $120k ARR, 20-seat pilot, renewal 2026-10-15. They signed up on hosted API; interested in Private/VPC next year. Current blockers: Okta SSO failing for some users, embedding latency from EU region (~350ms p50 -> reported spikes), strict PII requirements (wants KMS/HSM). Raj -> Maria (CS) is primary owner. Requested from Sales: contract PDF, client SSO metadata, sample failing request ids.

Maria Torres: Thanks @Raj — taking ownership. Quick plan: 1) Kickoff w/client this week; 2) Triage SSO with Support (Ana); 3) Run latency perf tests w/Eng (Lee); 4) Capture enablement docs + prompt templates. Can you drop contract + Okta metadata here? :pray:

Raj Patel: Dropping attachments in Okta/contract links in DM. Contact at Olympus is Priya Mehta (priya@olympus-fin.com), PM. Pilot scope: chat + embeddings for compliance search. They have a staging cluster in eu-west-1. I saw errors 2026-03-18 14:02:12 req=0x8f3b — 401 assertions.

Lee Chen: tagging @Maria — I'll run isolated perf tests against eu-west-1 model variants. Possible cause: client is hitting a larger model in hosted routing; we can test 1) quantized variant 2) smaller context window. Can you provide a sample payload or request id? Also, what's the sequence length distribution?

Maria Torres: Sample payload attached (redacted). Sequence length avg ~420 tokens during embeddings. I've scheduled a kickoff with Priya for Mon 10am PT.

Ana Gomez: I'll own SSO triage. Need: IdP metadata XML + SAML assertion example + affected user emails. I can enable detailed SSO logs for their tenant. ETA for first pass: 24 hours. @Raj please share the Okta admin contact.

Lee Chen: quick test command for dataset — run this from staging and paste output:

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED' \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":"<sample>..."}' | jq '.latency'
```

If we see large KV setup times we need to profile KV cache hit rates.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance reminder: model-variant rollout in eu-west-1 planned 1940015000 (UTC). If you need a freeze window for Olympus, reply with :no_entry_sign:.

Maria Torres: TL;DR action items:
- Maria: run client kickoff Mon 10am PT, gather enablement needs and prompt templates.
- Ana: SSO triage, provide findings in 24h.
- Lee: perf isolation tests + recommend model variant/quant settings by Thu EOD.
- Raj: share contract, Okta admin, and failing request ids (done in DM).
Please react with :thumbsup: if this looks right or add edits. I'll create a follow-up tracker in Jira and ping the group once created.

Raj Patel: :thumbsup: thanks team — Priya is on copy in email thread. Reach out if you need warm intro.
